decision_interpretation: Use direct road vehicles from assembly zone A to destination zone D with the baseline road fleet and schedule.
claim_boundary: Decision support comparator only; outcomes depend on congestion disruption severity and fleet assumptions.
notes: Baseline direct road option for paired comparison.

decision_interpretation: Use feeder shuttles to rail access S then scheduled rail to R and last-mile road vehicles to D under baseline assumptions.
claim_boundary: Conditional multimodal comparator only; it can be robust or fragile depending on access roads rail service transfers and last-mile capacity.
notes: Baseline rail-bus option for paired comparison.

decision_interpretation: Add redundant last-mile vehicle availability after rail egress to test whether R to D road capacity is the bottleneck.
claim_boundary: Tests one bottleneck relief mechanism; it does not assume redundancy is cost effective or generally faster.
notes: Scales last-mile fleet upward while leaving feeder rail and transfer assumptions unchanged.

decision_interpretation: Space feeder departures and release last-mile vehicles on demand when rail batches arrive to reduce schedule bunching.
claim_boundary: Represents a deterministic dispatch variant only; benefits may disappear under different arrival rail or road conditions.
notes: Uses existing on-demand last-mile behavior when interval is zero.

decision_interpretation: Increase feeder shuttle fleet availability from A to S to test whether access to rail constrains multimodal performance.
claim_boundary: Only isolates feeder capacity sensitivity; it does not resolve rail transfer or last-mile bottlenecks by itself.
notes: Scales shuttle fleet upward and leaves downstream resources unchanged.

decision_interpretation: Use a road-network variant with additional direct-road corridor redundancy where such a variant has been documented.
claim_boundary: Applicable only when the network variant represents a documented corridor option; it is not a calibrated route plan.
notes: For abstract tests this maps to the matched_redundancy variant; real-world pilots need an accepted equivalent graph.

decision_interpretation: Stress multimodal reliance on rail by lengthening rail travel and headway while reducing assumed train capacity.
claim_boundary: Scenario stress test only; it does not predict actual agency service availability during emergencies.
notes: Keeps rail available but degraded to expose conditional resilience limits.

decision_interpretation: Reduce feeder and last-mile vehicle availability to test how constrained road fleets affect multimodal completion.
claim_boundary: Stress case for sensitivity analysis only; it should be compared against matched assumptions and not read as a forecast.
notes: Uses deterministic scaling with at least one vehicle retained after rounding.
